instances.prompt: Documentary-style handheld shot. Two adult friends, a woman with a dark bob haircut in a mustard wool coat and a bearded man in a navy jacket, walk side by side along a busy city sidewalk talking and gesturing with their hands. The camera tracks backwards in front of them at walking pace, keeping both in a medium shot. Storefronts, parked cars and other pedestrians pass behind them. Natural overcast afternoon light. Realistic, 35mm film look.
